fullContentHtml:
Indian Army Agniveer CEE Admit Card 2026 - Complete Details

Short Information : Join Indian Army (Bhartiya Sena) has released the admit card for the Indian Army Common Entrance Exam (CEE) 2026–2027 on the official website of the Indian Army. Applications for the Indian Army Agniveer CEE Recruitment 2025 were accepted from February 12, 2026, to April 10, 2026. The CEE examination is going to be conducted on 01-16 June 2026. Candidates who had applied this form can download their Indian Army Agniveer CEE Admit Card 2026 from the link given below..

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 12 February 20256
  • Last Date : 10 April 2026
  • Last Date (RT JCO) : 10 April 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 10 April 2026
  • Exam Date : 01 to 16 June 2026
  • Admit Card : 15 May 2026

Application Fee

  • General, EWS, OBC : Rs. 250/-
  • SC, ST : Rs. 250/-
  • Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.
